proofs.text: Run the command in a checkout with no signing key; verify it exits 1, prints `git config gpg.format ssh`, `git config user.signingkey ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub` and `git config commit.gpgsign true`, and that the signatures directory is empty
Run the command in a separate process against a checkout with no signing key; verify it exits 1 and prints `git config gpg.format ssh`

rule_text: With no signing configured the command writes no signature, exits 1 and prints the three git config commands that set signing up

tests.body:
def test_without_signing_the_setup_is_printed_and_nothing_is_written(
            self, at_strong, capsys):
        code = sign_module.main(['login', '--project-root', at_strong.root])
        output = capsys.readouterr().out
        assert code == 1
        assert 'git config gpg.format ssh' in output
        assert 'git config user.signingkey ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub' in output
        assert 'git config commit.gpgsign true' in output
        assert at_strong.signatures() == []
tests.name: test_without_signing_the_setup_is_printed_and_nothing_is_written

def test_the_script_runs_as_a_command(self, at_strong):
        result = subprocess.run(
            [sys.executable, SIGN_PY, 'login', '--project-root',
             at_strong.root], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120)
        assert result.returncode == 1, result.stdout + result.stderr
        assert 'git config gpg.format ssh' in result.stdout
tests.name: test_the_script_runs_as_a_command
